{"ascii":"Live Canvas Agent API: reach the owning browser while preserving target and request identity
|-- [M] Command access: MCP -> HTTP tools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |-- Public boundary: schema-validated tools; mutation paths enforce read-only restrictions
|   |   `-- Attachment lookup, argument resolution and execution bookkeeping stay internal
|   |-- sessionId identifies canvasId + documentId + optional changeSessionId
|   |   |-- Explicit target -> lazily cached attachment
|   |   |-- Chat binding -> capture this turn's target; reject a conflicting attachment
|   |   `-- Proposal attachment must agree with the supplied changeSessionId
|   `-- [C] Live command -> CanvasSessionPort -> CanvasSessionBridge
|       |-- Queue command -> browser long-poll -> registered handler -> HTTP reply
|       |   `-- Reply must match pending command ID and canvas ID to settle dispatch
|       |-- [O] Browser hook owns ephemeral canvasId, polling and a bounded command-result cache
|       |   `-- Cleanup aborts polling and requests unregister; pagehide also requests unregister
|       `-- [O] Bridge owns registrations, queues, pending promises and timers
|           |-- Reply or timeout releases pending dispatch; timeout leaves outcome uncertain
|           `-- Registration retirement/unregister wakes pollers and rejects pending commands
|-- Execute semantic operations and recover uncertain acknowledgements
|   |-- [C] exec(code) -> QuickJsAgentRuntime -> validated host invocation
|   |   |-- Script sees frozen canvas, nodes and edges APIs
|   |   `-- [O] Each run gets a bounded QuickJS context; finally disposes it on success or failure
|   |-- [D] Mutation requires attachment + initial document version + resolved operation arguments
|   |   |-- Caller expectedVersion must equal the execution's initial document version
|   |   |-- Acknowledged writes advance the tracked version used by subsequent writes
|   |   `-- Source-mapping replacement also obtains the current diagram's ASCII content hash
|   |-- [C] Dispatch by attachment and execution mode
|   |   |-- Live document -> browser bridge above; proposal document -> ChangeSessionService.apply
|   |   |-- Immediate mode -> apply one operation -> return its result
|   |   `-- Batched mode -> retain operations; return queued IDs for dependent writes
|   |       `-- Read/barrier or successful script completion -> flush -> mutation receipts
|   |           `-- A queued ID identifies intended work; acknowledgement establishes its result
|   `-- Recovery: retry identical arguments with the same scoped requestId
|       |-- Tool requests: scope includes access mode, tool, attachment and proposal
|       |   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService retains signature + promise; changed input conflicts
|       |   `-- Recognized timeout/reply failures release the request entry to permit recovery
|       |-- Exec retry: retained run fixes API-step order, operation IDs and expected versions
|       |   |-- Rerun script -> replay completed API outcomes -> resend unacknowledged work
|       |   |-- Changed step signature or batch membership -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       |   |-- Catching a transport error in the script cannot turn uncertain work into success
|       |   `-- Success or non-transport failure releases run state; pure-read results are not retained
|       `-- Live copy/paste: a separate receipt scope is workspace + document + epoch + requestId
|           |-- LiveCanvasService retains command identity and result across timeout and retry
|           |-- Reader request -> owning publisher -> owner-checked reply -> recheck reader binding
|           |-- [D] Paste uses normalized ASCII + position + expected document version + fixed nodeId
|           |   `-- Successful reply must match that nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
|           `-- Receipts are instance-owned and never evicted; capacity exhaustion rejects new work
|-- Live selection access: a separate binding from command sessionId
|   |-- [M] /api/mapping/live first frame selects browser publisher or external reader
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService exposes selection/context reads, copy/paste and context upload
|   |   `-- Socket route checks roles and write/upload enablement before dispatch
|   |-- [O] Publisher owner token controls one workspace's selection mirror
|   |   `-- Reader connectionId pins workspaceInstanceId + documentId + canvasEpoch
|   |-- [C] Publish initial selection -> attach reader -> return bound snapshot
|   |   `-- Later same-epoch updates -> selection.delta notifications to active matching readers
|   |-- [D] Next selection requires a full snapshot OR previous selection + valid delta
|   |   |-- Delta requires matching epoch and baseSequence; apply removals and upserts
|   |   |-- Same-epoch updates at or below the retained sequence are ignored
|   |   `-- Selection sequence orders updates; documentVersion identifies the reported document state
|   |-- [D] Context response requires published selection + injected document-context loader
|   |   |-- Publisher identity and epoch must survive the asynchronous load
|   |   `-- Bound context reads also recheck connectionId after awaiting the load
|   |-- HTTP selection read -> bound snapshot; connectionId:sequence ETag can yield 304
|   `-- Close, replacement or disconnect -> invalidate bindings and reject pending copy/paste waits
|       |-- Reader socket close detaches its binding; publisher close disconnects its owner
|       `-- Slow readers reconnect for a fresh snapshot; transport does not silently discard deltas
|-- Compact anchor identity across API boundaries
|   |-- [M] CanvasApiProjection exposes projection and resolution; keeps handle maps internal
|   |   `-- Both services accept a projection instance; configured sharing belongs to runtime wiring
|   |-- [D] Outgoing handle and incoming full ID depend on the same instance-owned mapping
|   |   |-- Handles carry instance generation and revision/hash-derived scope
|   |   |-- Nodes, edges, jumps and migrations use these mappings; domain state retains full IDs
|   |   `-- Unknown compact handle -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE -> reread; full-ID callers remain supported
|   `-- [O] Maps never evict or reassign handles; exhausted capacity requires restart and reread
`-- Contracts with neighboring capabilities
    |-- Canvas domain -> semantic operations and current-state/display-node projections
    |-- Generation -> start edit/create/extend or batch runs; route status/cancel by runId
    |   `-- Application callbacks send revision/creation/batch payloads to the browser and await document version
    |-- Changes -> proposal-scoped snapshots and mutations; save_diagram cannot publish a proposal
    |-- Saved representations -> serialize saves per canvas/document
    |   |-- Whole-document save hands checkpointId to publishCheckpoint; node save isolates one diagram
    |   `-- Publication returns representation/revision identity; failed browser notice yields displayUpdated=false
    `-- Contexts -> saved-library operations and diagram-bound backing records
        |-- Prepare/delete require current document version and expected diagram revision
        `-- [D] Read status uses stored binding + current diagram source fingerprint
            `-- No binding -> absent; matching fingerprint -> ready; mismatch -> stale"}
